svg.title: Armory gallery layout, top-down
svg.text: Armory gallery - top-down, interior 12.0 x 20.0 m, 1 m grid
North (rear platform) at top. Drawn from build/layout.json (the kit as built). Cases are EMPTY; numbers are planned displays.
glass case on a black-lacquer plinth / hero table
steps, 4 risers x 15 cm, LED nosings
wide wall display bay (1.85 m, r20 round 3) over a dark dado (counter +0.85): lit cream back, two downlights at the head, empty
rear alcove: top-lit dark back board, empty upright rack, tansu, lattice above
painted panel (ink pine), 2.4 x 2.3 m, glowing border
slim newel post at the stair foot (0.85 m, 0.30 m top plate)
small lantern on the newel (hero, 0.32 m, +0.87)
black banner with the gold emblem
45 cm jamb post with iron straps (f2: the vestibule posts at Y 1.02)
the user's emblem on the top riser (f1)
blue = lattice window 3.5 x 1.45 m, sill +2.65 (both long walls)
cream on the west wall = window closed with a lit shoji pane
yellow = sun patches from the west windows: Sun_GoldenHour 18 deg up, heading 35, Sun_WindowFill 30 deg up, heading 37
1 (L): front-centre: smoke bombs, paper tags, kunai + tag, stars
3 (LN): rear-centre: Snow Flower drawn + empty sheath
5 (SF): small weapons: kunai (+ future tanto etc.)
10 (Hero): hero (table on the platform): Snow Flower sheathed
